note: Neither depends on the other. ERC-8004 publishes x402Support, uses agentWallet as the payee address, and lets feedback files carry proofOfPayment for an x402 payment; Erik Reppel co-authors ERC-8004 and sits on the x402 TSC.
The MPP payment discovery draft cites ERC-8004 and calls its off-chain discovery compatible with future on-chain anchoring; no integration is specified.
Indirect only: ERC-8004 lists A2A agent cards as services and AP2 can be implemented as an A2A extension. ERC-8226 is the closest on-chain analogue of an AP2 mandate.
